description: This PHP source file defines the class MAX_Dal_Admin_Variables, which manages database interactions related to 'variables' in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for retrieving tracker variables and updating variable codes, referencing multiple database tables and external classes.

classes.name: MAX_Dal_Admin_Variables
classes.description: A data access layer class for managing 'variables' in the Revive Adserver database, providing methods to retrieve tracker variables and update variable codes.

methods.name: getTrackerVariables
methods.description: Retrieves distinct variables associated with a specific zone and affiliate, optionally filtering for affiliate visibility, returning tracker and variable details.

methods.name: updateVariableCode
methods.description: Updates the code for all variables linked to a specific tracker ID, returning true if successful.
